description: This PHP class 'MapOSM' manages map-related data and configuration for a mapping feature, including properties like tile layer, dimensions, center, zoom, and map data overlays such as projects, workshops, donations, and GeoJSON. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties and a method to render a map canvas view.

classes.name: MapOSM
classes.description: Class managing OpenStreetMap map configurations and data overlays with methods for property access and rendering.
